title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 10 章‧驅魔誦詞
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, ahura mazda
mainyô spênishta dâtare gaêthanãm
astvaitinãm ashâum kutha aêtat druxsh perenâne
ýâ haca irista upa jvañtem upa-dvãsaiti
kutha aêtat nasush perenâne ýâ haca irista
upa jvañtem upa-raêthwaiti.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Ahura Mazda! most beneficent
Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How shall
I fight against that Druj who from the dead rushes upon the living?
How shall I fight against that Druj who from the dead defiles
the living?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：『物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！最仁慈的善靈啊！我應如何與那從死者身上撲向生者的德魯格搏鬥？我應如何與那從死者身上玷污生者的德魯格搏鬥？』

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ime vaca framrva
ýôi heñti gâthâhva bishâmrûta
ime vaca framrva ýôi heñti gâthâhva
thrishâmrûta ime vaca framrva ýôi heñti
gâthâhva cathrushâmrûta ime vaca framrva
ýôi heñti gâthâhva bishâmrûtaca
thrishâmrûtaca cathrushâmrûtaca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Say aloud those words in the Gathas
that are to be said twice .
'Say aloud those words in the Gathas that are to be said thrice.
'Say aloud those words in the Gathas that are to be said four
times.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『大聲誦唸迦薩中應誦唸兩次的那些言詞。大聲誦唸迦薩中應誦唸三次的那些言詞。大聲誦唸迦薩中應誦唸四次的那些言詞。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... kaya aête vaca ýôi heñti
gâthâhva bishâmrûta, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, ime aête vaca ýôi heñti
gâthâhva bishâmrûta ime vaca âdhbitîm
framrva,
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Which are those
words in the Gathas that are to be said twice?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！迦薩中應誦唸兩次的那些言詞是哪些？

segments.orig:
ahyâ ýâsâ ... humatanãm ...
ashahyâ âat sairî ... ýathâ tû-î
... humâîm thwâ îzhîm ... thwôi
staotarascâ ... ushtâ ahmâi ... speñtâ
mainyû ... vohû xshathrem ... vahishtâ îshtish....
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'These are the words in the Gathas that
are to be said twice, and thou shalt twice say them aloud:-
ahya yasa ... urvanem (Y28.2).
-----
humatenam ... mahi (Y35.2),
ashahya aad saire ... ahubya (Y35.8),
yatha tu i ... ahura (Y39.4),
humaim thwa ... hudaustema (Y41.3),
thwoi staotaraska ... ahura (Y41.5).
-----
usta ahmai ... manangho (Y43.1),
spenta mainyu ... ahuro (Y47.1),
vohu khshathrem ... vareshane (Y51.1),
vahista istis ... skyaothanaka (Y53.1).
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「這些是迦薩中應誦讀兩次的語詞，汝應大聲誦讀兩次：─
ahya yasa ... urvanem（Y28.2）。
─
humatem ... mahi（Y35.2），
ashahya aad saire ... ahubya（Y35.8），
yatha tu i ... ahura（Y39.4），
humaim thwa ... hudaustema（Y41.3），
thwoi staotaraska ... ahura（Y41.5）。
─
usta ahmai ... manangho（Y43.1），
spenta mainyu ... ahuro（Y47.1），
vohu khshathrem ... vareshane（Y51.1），
vahista istis ... skyaothanaka（Y53.1）。」

segments.orig:
âat pasca bishâmrûta vaca ime vaca framrva
vârethrakhne baêshazya, paiti-perene angrem mainyûm
haca nmâna haca vîsa haca zañtu haca dainghu
haca havayåse-tanvô haca nâ paiti-iristô
haca nâirika paiti-iriste haca nmânahe nmânô-patôish
haca vîsô vîspatôish haca zañtêush
zañtupatôish haca dainghêush dainghupatôish
haca vîspayå ashaonô stôish.
segments.en:
'And after thou hast twice said those Bis-amrutas, thou shalt
say aloud these victorious, most healing words:-
'"I drive away Angra Mainyu from this house, from this borough,
from this town, from this land; from the very body of the man
defiled by the dead, from the very body of the woman defiled by
the dead; from the master of the house, from the lord of the borough,
from the lord of the town, from the lord of the land; from the
whole of the world of Righteousness.
segments.zh:
『在你誦唸完兩次那些雙誦言詞之後，你應大聲說出這些勝利之言、最具治癒之力的言詞：
『「我驅逐安格拉‧曼紐離開這座家宅，離開這座村鎮，離開這座城邑，離開這片大地；離開被死者玷污的人的身體，離開被死者玷污的女人的身體；離開家宅之主，離開村鎮之主，離開城邑之主，離開大地之主；離開整個阿沙之世界。

segments.orig:
paiti-perene nasûm paiti-perene hãm-raêthwem
paiti-perene paiti-raêthwem haca nmâna haca vîsa
haca zañtu haca dainghu haca havayåse-tanvô
haca nâ paiti-iristô haca nâirika paiti-iriste
haca nmânahe nmânô-patôish haca vîsô
vîspatôish haca zañtêush zañtupatôish
haca dainghêush dainghupatôish haca vîspayå
ashaonô stôish.
segments.en:
'"I drive away the Nasu, I drive away direct defilement,
I drive away indirect defilement, from this house, from this borough,
from this town, from this land; from the very body of the man
defiled by the dead, from the very body of the woman defiled by
the dead; from the master of the house, from the lord of the borough,
from the lord of the town, from the lord of the land; from the
whole of the world of Righteousness."'
segments.zh: 『「我驅逐納蘇，我驅逐直接之玷污，我驅逐間接之玷污，離開這座家宅，離開這座村鎮，離開這座城邑，離開這片大地；離開被死者玷污的人的身體，離開被死者玷污的女人的身體；離開家宅之主，離開村鎮之主，離開城邑之主，離開大地之主；離開整個阿沙之世界。』』」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... kaya aête vaca ýôi heñti
gâthâhva thrishâmrûta, âat mraot
ahurô mazdå, ime aête vaca ýôi
heñti gâthâhva thrishâmrûta ime
vaca âthritîm framrva,
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Which are those
words in the Gathas that are to be said thrice?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！迦薩中應誦唸三次的那些言詞是哪些？

segments.orig:
ashem vohû ... ýê sevishtô ... huxshathrôtemâi
... duzhvarenâish....
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'These are the words in the Gathas that
are to be said thrice, and thou shalt thrice say them aloud:-
ashem vohu ... (Y27.14),
ye sevisto ... paitî (Y33.11),
hukhshathrotemai ... vahistai (Y35.5),
duzvarenais ... vahyo (Y53.9).
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「這些是迦薩中應誦讀三次的語詞，汝應大聲誦讀三次：─
ashem vohu ...（Y27.14），
ye sevisto ... paitî（Y33.11），
hukhshathrotemai ... vahistai（Y35.5），
duzvarenais ... vahyo（Y53.9）。」

segments.orig:
âat pasca thrishâmrûta vaca ime vaca framrva
vârethrakhne baêshazya, paiti-perene iñdrem
paiti-perene saurum paiti-perene nånghaithîm daêum
haca nmâna haca vîsa haca zañtu haca dainghu.
segments.en:
'After thou hast thrice said those Thris-amrutas, thou shalt
say aloud these victorious, most healing words:-
'"I drive away Indra, I drive away Sauru, I drive away 
the daeva Naunghaithya, from this house, from this borough, from
this town, from this land; from the very body of the man defiled
by the dead, from the very body of the woman defiled by the dead;
from the master of the house, from the lord of the borough, from
the lord of the town, from the lord of the land; from the whole
of the world of Righteousness.
segments.zh:
「在你三遍誦說那三次之言後，你應大聲誦說這些勝利的、最有療癒之力的言詞：
「我驅逐因陀羅，我驅逐蘇魯，我驅逐迭瓦納翁蓋西亞，遠離此宅舍，遠離此聚落，遠離此城鎮，遠離此國土；遠離被死者所汙的男子之軀體，遠離被死者所汙的女子之軀體；遠離家主，遠離聚落之主，遠離城鎮之主，遠離國土之主；遠離整個正義之世界。

segments.orig:
paiti-perene tauru paiti-perene zairica haca nmâna haca
vîsa haca zañtu haca dainghu.
segments.en:
'"I drive away Tauru , I drive away Zairi, from this
house, from this borough, from this town, from this land; from
the very body of the man defiled by the dead, from the very body
of the woman defiled by the dead; from the master of the house,
from the lord of the borough, from the lord of the town, from
the lord of the land; from the whole of the holy world."'
segments.zh: 「我驅逐托魯，我驅逐扎伊里，遠離此宅舍，遠離此聚落，遠離此城鎮，遠離此國土；遠離被死者所汙的男子之軀體，遠離被死者所汙的女子之軀體；遠離家主，遠離聚落之主，遠離城鎮之主，遠離國土之主；遠離整個聖潔之世界。」」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... kaya aête vaca ýôi heñti
gâthâhva cathrushâmrûta, âat mraot
ahurô mazdå, ime aête vaca ýôi
heñti gâthâhva cathrushâmrûta ime
vaca âxtûirîm framrva,
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Which are those
words in the Gathas that are to be said four times?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！迦薩中哪些言詞應被四次誦說？

segments.orig:
ýathâ ahû vairyô ... mazdâ
at môi ... â airyêmâ ishyô....
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'These are the words in the Gathas that
are to be said four times, and thou shalt four times say them
aloud:-
yatha ahu vairyo ... (Y27.13),
mazda ad moi ... dau ahum (Y34.15),
a airyama ishyo ... masata mazdau (Y54.1).
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「這些是迦薩中應被四次誦說的言詞，你應四次大聲誦說它們：
耶薩‧阿胡‧瓦依里奧……（Y27.13），
馬茲達‧阿德‧莫伊……‧道‧阿胡姆（Y34.15），
阿‧艾里亞瑪‧伊什奧……‧瑪薩塔‧馬茲道（Y54.1）。

segments.orig:
âat pasca cathrushâmrûta vaca ime vaca framrva
vârethrakhne baêshazya, paiti-perene aêshmem
xrvîm-drûm paiti-perene akatashem daêum haca
nmâna haca vîsa haca zañtu haca dainghu.
segments.en:
'After thou hast said those Chathrus-amrutas four times, thou
shalt say aloud these victorious, most healing words:-
'"I drive away Aeshma, the fiend of the murderous spear,
I drive away the daeva Akatasha, from this house, from this borough,
from this town, from this land; from the very body of the man
defiled by the dead, from the very body of the woman defiled by
the dead; from the master of the house, from the lord of the borough,
from the lord of the town, from the lord of the land; from the
whole of the world of Righteousness.
segments.zh:
「在你四次誦說那四次之言後，你應大聲誦說這些勝利的、最有療癒之力的言詞：
「我驅逐埃什瑪，謀殺矛槍的魔鬼，我驅逐迭瓦阿卡塔沙，遠離此宅舍，遠離此聚落，遠離此城鎮，遠離此國土；遠離被死者所汙的男子之軀體，遠離被死者所汙的女子之軀體；遠離家主，遠離聚落之主，遠離城鎮之主，遠離國土之主；遠離整個正義之世界。

segments.orig:
paiti-perene varenya daêvô paiti-perene vâtîm
daêvô haca nmâna haca vîsa haca zañtu
haca dainghu.
segments.en:
'"I drive away the Varenya daevas, I drive away the
wind-daeva, from this house, from this borough, from this town,
from this land; from the very body of the man defiled by the dead,
from the very body of the woman defiled by the dead; from the
master of the house, from the lord of the borough, from the lord
of the town, from the lord of the land; from the whole of the
world of Righteousness."
segments.zh: 「我驅逐瓦雷尼亞迭瓦，我驅逐風迭瓦，遠離此宅舍，遠離此聚落，遠離此城鎮，遠離此國土；遠離被死者所汙的男子之軀體，遠離被死者所汙的女子之軀體；遠離家主，遠離聚落之主，遠離城鎮之主，遠離國土之主；遠離整個正義之世界。」」

segments.orig:
ime aête vaca ýôi heñti gâthâhva
bishâmrûta ime aête vaca ýôi heñti
gâthâhva thrishâmrûta ime aête vaca
ýôi heñti gâthâhva cathrushâmrûta.
segments.zh: 「這些是迦薩中應被二次誦說的言詞；這些是迦薩中應被三次誦說的言詞；這些是迦薩中應被四次誦說的言詞。

segments.orig:
ime aête vaca ýôi heñti angrahe
mainyêush snathem ime aête vaca ýôi heñti
aêshmahe xrvîm-draosh snathem ime aête vaca
ýôi heñti mâzainyanãm daêvanãm
snathem ime aête vaca ýôi heñti vîspanãm
daêvanãm snathem.
segments.en:
'These are the words that smite down Angra Mainyu; these are
the words that smite down Aeshma, the fiend of the murderous spear;
these are the words that smite down the daevas of Mazana; these
are the words that smite down all the daevas.
segments.zh: 「這些是擊打安格拉‧曼紐的言詞；這些是擊打埃什瑪、謀殺矛槍的魔鬼的言詞；這些是擊打馬札納迭瓦的言詞；這些是擊打所有迭瓦的言詞。」

segments.orig:
ime aête vaca ýôi heñti avainghå
drujô avainghå nasâvô hamaêstârem
ýâ haca irista upa jvañtem upa- dvãsaiti
ime aête vaca ýôi heñti avainghå
drujô avainghå nasâvô hamaêstârem
ýâ haca irista upa jvañtem upa-raêthwaiti.
segments.en:
'These are the words that stand, against that Druj, against
that Nasu, who from the dead rushes upon the living, who from
the dead defiles the living.
segments.zh: 「這些是立於那德魯格、立於那納蘇之前的言辭，那納蘇從死者衝向生者，那納蘇從死者玷污生者。」

segments.orig:
âat tûm zarathushtra nava makha nithweresôish
ýat anghat ainghå zemô vî-âpôtememca
vî-urvarô-tememca ana- hvaretha pasu-vîra, ýaozhdå
mashyâi aipi zãthem vahishta hâ ýaozhdå
zarathushtra ýâ daêna mâzdayasnish ýô
hvãm daênãm ýaozhdâite humatâishca
hûxtâishca hvarshtâishca.
segments.en:
'Therefore, O Zarathushtra! thou shalt dig nine holes in
the part of the ground where there is least water and where there
are fewest trees; where there is nothing that may be food either
for man or beast; "for purity is for man, next to life, the,
greatest good, that purity, O Zarathushtra, that is in the Religion
of Mazda for him who cleanses his own self with good thoughts,
words, and deeds."
segments.zh: 「因此，查拉圖斯特拉啊！你應在地面上最少水、最少樹木之處掘九個洞；那處無任何可作人或獸之食物的東西；『潔淨對人來說，僅次於生命，是最大的善，查拉圖斯特拉啊，那潔淨，是在馬茲達的信仰中，為那以善念、善言、善行淨化自身者而有的。』」

segments.orig:
daênãm erezvô ýaozhdaithîsha
atha zî ainghå asti ýaozhdâitish kahmâicit
anghêush astvatô havayå erezvô daênayå
ýô hvãm daênãm ýaozhdâite
humatâishca hûxtâishca hvarshtâishca.
segments.en:
'Make thy own self pure, O righteous man! any one in the world
here below can win purity for his own self, namely, when he cleanses
his own self with good thoughts, words, and deeds.
segments.zh: 「淨化你自身吧，義人啊！下方世界中任何人都能為自身贏得潔淨，即當他以善念、善言、善行淨化自身時。」

segments.orig:
ýathâ ahû vairyô ... kêm-nâ
mazdâ ... mâmereñcainîsh gaêthå
astvaitîsh ashahe! ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'"Yatha ahu vairyo: - The will of the Lord is the law
of righteousness," &c.
'"Kem-na mazda: - What protector hast thou given unto me,
O Mazda! while the hate of the wicked encompasses me?" &c.
'"Ke verethrem-ja: - Who is the victorious who will protect
thy teaching?" &c.
'"Keep us from our hater, O Mazda and Armaiti Spenta! Perish,
O fiendish Druj! ... Perish away to the regions of the north,
never more to give unto death the living world of Righteousness!"'
segments.zh: 「『依然阿胡‧瓦伊雷：——主之意志乃義正之法，』等等。『凱姆納‧馬茲達：——當惡人之恨環繞我時，啊馬茲達，你曾給我何護者？』等等。『凱‧瓦雷特瑞姆賈：——誰是勝者，將護衛你的教誨？』等等。『保護我們免於我們的仇恨者，啊馬茲達與斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提！願惡靈德魯格滅亡！……願其消亡至北方之地，永不再給義正的生靈世界帶來死亡！』」
